issue.title: Fix dashboard export
issue.body:
Steps to reproduce:
1. Open a pivot table chart with a temporal column.
2. Set the time grain to `month`.

Expected behavior: the column headers show the month for each bucket.
Actual behavior: every header shows `Invalid date` and the console logs `RangeError: Invalid time value`.
Affected code: `superset-frontend/plugins/plugin-chart-pivot-table/src/PivotTableChart.tsx`.
Acceptance criteria: headers render the month and the plugin unit tests pass.
